text: ___ (SHapley Additive exPlanations) is a model interpretability technique that can be applied to tree-based models through a TreeExplainer to quantify how much each feature contributes to an individual prediction.
explanation: SHAP values, grounded in cooperative game theory's Shapley values, quantify each feature's contribution to a specific prediction and are commonly applied to random forest or other tree-based models using `shap.TreeExplainer`.
